name: Jellyverse
description: Jellyverse is a comprehensive DeFi ecosystem that includes a decentralized exchange (DEX), a staking protocol, and a synthetics protocol. It is introducing DeFi 3.0 by creating a sustainable, yield-driven environment, giving access to synthetic and non-synthetic RWAs.

methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
